before: The snake moves at a fixed speed of 8 steps per second. Each movement step advances the snake head exactly one grid cell.
after: The snake moves at a fixed speed of 10 steps per second. Each movement step advances the snake head exactly one grid cell.

before: While `playing`, the program continuously processes directional input and updates the snake at a fixed rate of 8 movement steps per second.
after: While `playing`, the program continuously processes directional input and updates the snake at a fixed rate of 10 movement steps per second.
